layout: Each sheet: four terrain rows, four seasonal columns (Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter). Exported as 384px WebP terrain tiles.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: a production-ready square 2048x2048 terrain sprite atlas for a richly illustrated medieval hex board game. EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal square cells, perfectly aligned at quarter-width and quarter-height, no gutters, no frames, no text, no labels, no grid lines. Each cell is an independent full-bleed landscape seen from steep overhead isometric view, no horizon, no sky. Important details in central 70% survive a hexagonal crop. Hand-painted realistic miniature terrain, detailed but readable at 128px, deep natural colors, soft daylight, clear resource cues, matching premium board-game pine forest illustrations. No characters, buildings, UI, symbols, watermarks. Each row repeats the same terrain and camera across its four seasons: columns SPRING, SUMMER, AUTUMN, WINTER, left to right. Seasons must visibly change the vegetation and weather while preserving the terrain and main features. Render exactly the specified rows and season conditions. Climate: treeless subpolar TUNDRA, never any trees. Spring has lingering melting snow around thawed wet soil, Summer carpet of moss and low green shrubs without snow, Autumn red-gold dwarf shrubs with a little early frost, Winter dense snow with wind-scoured exposed ground. ROW 1: low berry heath, clusters of amber cloudberries and small berry shrubs among moss hummocks; a resource landscape not a closeup fruit still life. ROW 2: musk ox pasture with 3 recognizable shaggy dark musk oxen, curved horns, coarse wool; season-appropriate tundra ground. ROW 3: reindeer range with 3 recognizable antlered reindeer amongst lichens. ROW 4: peat bog with dark brown rectangular peat cutting faces and small stacked peat blocks in center, mossy shallow pools. Winter peat face remains visible.
